problems.reason: Both sentences state that the brow of Eocarcharia was covered in keratin.
Sentence 12 claims Sereno and Brusatte described Eocarcharia in 2008, while sentence 17 says they named the genus Kryptops palaios in the same paper, implying a different genus.
Sentence 16 places Eocarcharia in Carcharodontosauridae, whereas sentence 21 classifies it as a spinosaurid.

notes: - contradiction: "Eocarcharia was formally described in 2008 by Paul Sereno and Steve Brusatte." / "Sereno and Brusatte named the genus Kryptops palaios in their 2008 paper describing Eocarcharia.": Sentence 12 claims Sereno and Brusatte described Eocarcharia in 2008, while sentence 17 says they named the genus Kryptops palaios in the same paper, implying a different genus.

- contradiction: "Sereno and Brusatte described Eocarcharia in 2008 as an early-diverging allosauroid theropod within the family Carcharodontosauridae." / "Cau and Paterna considered Eocarcharia to be a spinosaurid based on its similarities to Suchomimus, Ceratosuchops, and Riparovenator.": Sentence 16 places Eocarcharia in Carcharodontosauridae, whereas sentence 21 classifies it as a spinosaurid.
